answer_1.quote: Recent work has tackled this data-to-text generation task

answer_2.quote: We assess each system/strategy with five widely-used automatic metrics that measure the generation quality... ROUGE, BLEU, METEOR, BertScore, PARENT.

answer_4.quote: To quantitatively compare generated text... we develop a new counting and ranking-based annotation schema, and use it to conduct human evaluation. We collected the error annotations from two domain experts and the fluency annotations from crowd-sourced workers.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators count factual errors, hallucination errors, information misses, and rank fluency preferences based on grammar, structure, and coherence.
